title: Signal-Deficit Late-Session Existing-Book Relative Dislocation

macro_program.name: order_time_session
macro_program.reason: The intervention is a single post-native-window handoff clock and bounded same-day holding interval. The market state supplies direction, but the decision-changing mechanism is whether the unused late session can add one independent opportunity after the current clocks finish.

research_height.transfer_path: completed native-signal drought at 18:00 -> one US30 or US100 relative-dislocation opportunity at 19:00 -> exact-two-signal day coverage and later whole-portfolio occupancy/value evaluation

central_question: On normal days where all six current components have completed their native windows but produced fewer than three signals, does the more relatively displaced existing US30 or US100 book from 12:00 to 18:00 support a cost-positive four-hour continuation or reversion from 19:00 to 23:00 broadly enough to retain one later full-portfolio Lab candidate?

lenses: mechanism: construct one causal late-session relative displacement only after every current native signal clock has ended
direction and temporal replication: let P1 select at most one of continuation or reversion, then require separate P2 and P3 confirmation and a P4 latest-period veto
portfolio transmission and falsification: quantify exact-two-signal day coverage while requiring both existing books, both displacement signs and non-concentrated period contribution
research_bundle.common_boundary: The completed same-day native-signal count selects only signal-deficit dates at 18:00. Exact H1 price and spread rows define one fixed 19:00-to-23:00 trade-free proxy. No threshold, alternate clock, alternate holding horizon, subgroup or portfolio admission counterfactual is evaluated.

program_assessment.1: Unit 085 established an upstream signal-supply bottleneck and retained one independent-discovery seed; another descriptive signal-count split would be adjacent.
program_assessment.2: Unit 084 consumed the new H1 participation role ambiguously; no volume, participation or external-state variant is reopened.
program_assessment.3: The finished native clocks create a distinct dense late-session handoff whose truth changes whether unused session time merits a full-portfolio implementation candidate.
program_assessment.4: Remaining extrema, MAE and partial-close notions still lack a previsible clean trigger and do not address the newly proven upstream supply gap.
program_assessment.5: Capacity, removal, slot and risk mechanisms remain closed or invalid and cannot create missing native opportunities from the observed signal set.
program_assessment.7: RLO1 remains a future natural evidence role, but Live cannot be polled merely for context and no synthetic candidate row is permitted.

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 085 found that 918 of the 994 daily-start shortfall remains even with perfect conversion of every observed native signal, while deficit-day admitted value was non-adverse. A new opportunity mechanism, not admission relaxation, is therefore the connected bottleneck.
connection_bridge: All 2,429 frozen native SIGNAL_DECIDED events occur between server 12:15 and 17:00, so the fewer-than-three state is complete before the 18:00 market-state observation and the 19:00 entry proxy.

One eligible candidate exists on 353 of 363 exact-two-signal days. If later validated and admitted, those dates alone raise structural signal-compliant coverage from 433 to 786 of 1,051 normal days, a 33.5871 percentage-point upper-bound gain.
The candidate trades only the existing US30 or US100 books; US500 supplies a market-center reference and creates no new traded-symbol integration claim.
why_now.perspective_distance_from_recent: Unit 085 was Program 1 completed-day supply diagnosis. Unit 086 is Program 3 causal late-session handoff with a new forward-price outcome, discovery/confirmation time split and direct existing-book entry decision.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one future full-portfolio real-tick Lab candidate with the frozen direction, signal and 19:00-to-23:00 schedule. It must preserve all six current components and separately evaluate admission, occupancy, risk, lot, slot, opportunity cost and actual execution.
why_now.decision_if_false: Discard this late-session relative-dislocation mechanism and preserve all current behavior; do not vary its clock, return window, threshold, horizon, symbol subset or direction subgroup.
why_now.decision_if_invalid: Preserve all current behavior and retain no candidate because the fixed price/spread proxy cannot answer the question.

distinction_from_closed_work.unit_022: Unit 022 was a continuous M5, volatility-normalized, threshold-and-rearm, three-tradable-symbol 30-minute observer and closed invalid before economics. Unit 086 does not repair or rerun that observer. It uses completed native-signal drought days, an exact 12:00-to-18:00 H1 cross-section, only existing US30/US100 trade targets, a causally separated 19:00 entry and a fixed four-hour same-day horizon. Unit 085 supplies the new decision-changing portfolio evidence required to revisit the broad relative-price mechanism.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_064: Unit 064 decomposed the existing Cross component's US100 lifecycle into common beta and residual dilution. Unit 086 creates one independent post-window opportunity and does not alter Cross, hedge its lifecycle or size a peer leg.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_076: Unit 076 used a predecision 24-hour dispersion tercile to condition existing lifecycle value. Unit 086 has no regime tercile or allocation treatment and evaluates a new forward candidate after current windows finish.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_084: Unit 084 used completed 11:00 tick volume as broker participation and closed ambiguous. Unit 086 uses only price and spread columns at new causal clocks; it is neither a volume transform nor a participation-state successor.

every signal-deficit date with exact US30, US100 and US500 H1 12:00 and 18:00 opens

premetric_structural_feasibility.scope: Only event type, server date/time, H1 12:00 and 18:00 opens, exact 19:00/23:00 row presence and signal-state geometry were used. No 19:00 or 23:00 price/spread outcome, direction P/L, profit factor, drawdown, gate or verdict was cast or aggregated.

fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.normal_day: Exactly one CP2 SIZE_DAY date within its fresh period.
fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.deficit_state: At 18:00, after the frozen latest native decision time 17:00, fewer than three same-date SIGNAL_DECIDED events.
fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.signal_return: For each of US30, US100 and US500, log(exact 18:00 H1 open divided by exact 12:00 H1 open).
fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.market_center: The ordinary median of the three signal returns.
fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.tradable_residuals: US30 return minus the market center and US100 return minus the market center. US500 is context only.
fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.selected_symbol: Whichever of US30 or US100 has the larger absolute residual. Exact absolute ties are ineligible and are not broken by symbol preference.

direction_books.CONTINUATION: same sign as the selected residual
direction_books.REVERSION: opposite sign to the selected residual

fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.entry: Exact selected-symbol 19:00 H1 open, one full hour after the state clock, to keep signal construction and the bar-open execution proxy causally separated.
fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.exit: Exact selected-symbol 23:00 H1 open, four physical hours after entry and before server-date rollover.
fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.missing_rule: Any missing or nonpositive required signal/entry/exit open, negative spread, duplicate timestamp or nonfinite value makes that date ineligible or the integrity gate fail as specified; no imputation.
fixed_signal_and_trade_proxy.concurrency: At most one candidate per server date. Candidate-to-candidate overlap is impossible under the fixed 19:00-to-23:00 schedule.

fixed_cost_proxy.h1_open_semantics: The export open is treated as bid; ask equals bid plus spread times point.
fixed_cost_proxy.entry_mid: entry bid plus one half entry spread in price units
fixed_cost_proxy.exit_mid: exit bid plus one half exit spread in price units
fixed_cost_proxy.gross_usd: direction sign times (exit midpoint minus entry midpoint) times contract size times volume
fixed_cost_proxy.observed_spread_usd: gross USD minus one half of the entry-plus-exit full-spread price burden times contract size times volume
fixed_cost_proxy.double_spread_usd: gross USD minus the full entry-plus-exit spread price burden times contract size times volume
fixed_cost_proxy.commission_swap_financing: zero in this four-hour trade-free proxy; any retained candidate must later use normal real-tick Tester deal economics
fixed_cost_proxy.economic_authority: double_spread_usd is binding; observed_spread_usd and gross_usd are descriptive

fixed_period_roles.P1_2022H2_2023: direction discovery only; report 2022H2 and 2023 separately
fixed_period_roles.selection_leakage: P2-P4 outcomes cannot select direction, signal, threshold, cost, clock or horizon. If neither direction passes P1, do not calculate P2-P4 economics.

fixed_reports.structural: Report normal/deficit/exact-two dates, eligibility, missing causes, symbol and residual-sign counts, per-period density and structural compliant-day upper bound.
fixed_reports.direction_discovery: For both P1 direction books report gross, observed and double-spread net, double-spread profit factor, maximum closed drawdown, net-to-drawdown, count, win rate, mean and the two calendar-split and two-symbol nets.
fixed_reports.selected_confirmation: For only the selected direction report the same metrics pooled and by P2, P3, P4, symbol and residual sign.
fixed_reports.concentration: Report each period and symbol share of positive double-spread net when all required cells are positive.
fixed_reports.limits: State that H1 open/spread proxy evidence cannot establish exact tick execution, portfolio admission, overlap, risk, lot, slot or incremental whole-portfolio value.

requirements: All thirteen immutable inputs retain exact byte lengths and SHA-256 hashes and the three pinned closures retain their frozen verdict boundaries.
Reconstruct exactly 1,051 normal dates, 2,429 native signals, 618 signal-deficit dates, 363 exact-two-signal dates and native decision times no later than 17:00.
Reconstruct exactly 576 candidates, seven signal-bar-missing dates, 35 selected-trade-bar-missing dates, zero ties, 353 exact-two candidates, symbol counts 257/319 and residual-side counts 286/290.
Every candidate has unique date, finite nonzero selected residual, positive required opens, nonnegative integer spreads and exact period ownership.
Candidate coverage is at least 90% of signal-deficit dates pooled and in every period; exact-two coverage is at least 90% pooled and in every period.
There are at least 500 candidates pooled, at least 80 in every period and at least 50 in each P1 calendar split.
Neither selected symbol nor residual sign supplies more than 60% of candidates pooled.
P1 pooled double-spread net USD is strictly positive.
P1 pooled double-spread profit factor is at least 1.10.
P1 pooled double-spread net divided by maximum closed drawdown is at least 1.25.
Double-spread net USD is strictly positive in both P1_2022H2 and P1_2023.
Double-spread net USD is strictly positive for both selected US30 and selected US100 candidates within P1.
fixed_p1_direction_selection_gate.selection: If exactly one direction passes, select it. If both pass, select greater P1 double-spread net-to-drawdown, then greater profit factor, then greater net USD, then REVERSION before CONTINUATION. If neither passes, close economic failure and do not calculate P2-P4 economics.

requirements: Selected-direction double-spread net USD is strictly positive and profit factor at least 1.05 separately in P2 and P3.
Pooled P2-plus-P3 double-spread profit factor is at least 1.10 and net-to-maximum-closed-drawdown at least 1.25.
Pooled P2-plus-P3 double-spread net is strictly positive for both selected symbols and nonnegative for both residual signs.
P4 selected-direction double-spread net is nonnegative and profit factor is at least 1.00.
P1 selection and every confirmation/latest requirement pass without changing direction or any signal/cost rule.
All-period selected-direction double-spread net is strictly positive, profit factor at least 1.10 and net-to-maximum-closed-drawdown at least 1.50.
All-period double-spread net is strictly positive for both selected symbols and both residual signs.
Every period has positive double-spread net, no period contributes more than 60% of total positive period net and no symbol contributes more than 70% of total positive symbol net.
The frozen structural candidate covers at least 90% of exact-two-signal days pooled and in every period.

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_LATE_SESSION_RELATIVE_DISLOCATION_RETAIN_ONE_FULL_PORTFOLIO_LAB_CANDIDATE when integrity/density, one P1 direction, confirmation/latest and every full-candidate requirement pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.discovery_failure: FAIL_LATE_SESSION_RELATIVE_DISLOCATION_NO_P1_DIRECTION_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity/density pass but neither fixed direction passes P1.
fixed_verdict_rules.confirmation_failure: FAIL_LATE_SESSION_RELATIVE_DISLOCATION_OUT_OF_SAMPLE_OR_LATEST_NO_CANDIDATE when a P1 direction is selected but any confirmation, latest or full-candidate requirement fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_LATE_SESSION_RELATIVE_DISLOCATION_NO_VERDICT_NO_CANDIDATE when any immutable, reconstruction, causal, price/spread or density requirement fails.

decision_translation.pass: Freeze this source-free family and retain exactly one unopened whole-portfolio real-tick Lab candidate using the selected direction and unchanged signal/clock/horizon. A later separately declared unit must preserve all six current components and measure actual entry, admission, occupancy, risk, lot, slot, cost and opportunity interaction.
decision_translation.failure: Discard the mechanism and preserve every current component and entry/order/risk/lot/slot/exit behavior. Retain no threshold, clock, horizon, symbol or subgroup seed.
decision_translation.invalid: Retain no candidate and do not repair the proxy automatically.

stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration, state and Frontier memory before accessing any 19:00/23:00 price or spread outcome, direction P/L, profit factor, drawdown, gate or verdict.
Run exactly one fixed source-free aggregation. One implementation-only correction is allowed only before any new economic metric is emitted; after a metric, no correction or rerun is permitted.
If no P1 direction passes, do not calculate or report P2-P4 economic outcomes.
Do not vary clock, window, horizon, threshold, symbol scope, residual construction, cost rule or subgroup after any result.

Freeze result and closure, update only the single Frontier memory and minimal state, commit only this repository's current changes to main, push origin/main, then recompare every active program before any successor.
Do not touch or poll Live, query broker/account/position/order/deal state, create a runtime, compile MQL, run Tester or open Program 6.
